model.title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 86 Main Street in Haverstraw, New York, as the Paul Piperato Post Office Building.
model.meta: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee, Oversight and Government Reform Committee · Rep. Michael Lawler (R-NY)

summary.text: The bill would rename the U.S. Postal Service facility at 86 Main Street in Haverstraw, New York, in honor of Paul Piperato.
